text: Mississippi Ventures, an investment vehicle of the Van Eerd family, completed the takeover of the remaining 50% of HEMA's shares in February 2026, placing HEMA within the holding Van Eerd Retail.
short: The Van Eerd family's investment vehicle Mississippi Ventures completed the HEMA takeover.

source.name: HEMA Corporate: Overname HEMA afgerond door Van Eerd Retail
source.quote: rondt Mississippi Ventures, een investeringsvehikel van de familie van Eerd, vandaag de overname van de resterende 50% van de aandelen HEMA af
source.note: Dutch; translation: '...Mississippi Ventures, an investment vehicle of the Van Eerd family, today completes the takeover of the remaining 50% of HEMA's shares.' The next sentence places HEMA within the holding Van Eerd Retail (quoted on claim jumbo-van-eerd-holding).
